cues.en: Mike: Permutation testing has quite a few advantages.
cues.zh: Mike：置換檢定有很多優點。

cues.en: It's a great technique for many reasons, but it does have one limitation, and it's a weird feature of permutation testing,
cues.zh: 很多原因讓它成為很好的技術，但有個限制，也是奇怪特性，

cues.en: and that is that this z-value that we compute is by definition going to be different every single time you run the analysis.
cues.zh: 就是算出的 Z 值，每次執行分析，依定義都會不同。

cues.en: And that's because we are generating an empirical null hypothesis based on randomizing data, based on picking random numbers.
cues.zh: 因為根據隨機化資料、選隨機數，建立經驗虛無假設。

cues.en: So, this z-value and therefore the corresponding p-value is always going to be different every time you run the test.
cues.zh: 所以 Z 值和對應 P 值，每次都會不同。

cues.en: Even if your data don't change, your data stay exactly the same, but you keep running the script over and over and over again, and every time you're gonna get at least a slightly different result.
cues.zh: 即使資料完全不變，不斷重跑指令碼，每次至少有一點差異。

cues.en: It's not gonna be wildly different, but it is a little awkward that you're always going to get a different result.
cues.zh: 不會差得很離譜，但總是得到不同結果，有點尷尬。

cues.en: So, how do you know how many permutations you should do?
cues.zh: 怎麼知道應做多少次置換？

cues.en: So, up here I did 1,000 permutations, 1,000 iterations, and maybe you think that if we did more, it would become more stable
cues.zh: 上面做了 1000 次置換、1000 次迭代，也許認為多做一點會更穩定，

cues.en: and if we had 10,000 iterations, it would be even better.
cues.zh: 1 萬次會更好。

cues.en: Well, it turns out that, you know, more iterations is better, but it's only better up to a certain point.
cues.zh: 次數多比較好，但只好到某個程度。

cues.en: You're still going to get variability for the same reason that you get sampling variability when you randomly sample from a population, you just get random numbers.
cues.zh: 仍然有變異，原因和從母體隨機抽樣時的抽樣變異一樣，就是隨機數。

cues.en: So, what is the solution?
cues.zh: 那解法是什麼？

cues.en: How do we deal with this?
cues.zh: 如何處理？

cues.en: If you would like to pause the video here before I finish telling you about the unsupervised learning project and think about how to deal with this.
cues.zh: 在說完「非監督式學習」專題前，可以暫停影片思考。

cues.en: There's things that you learned, concepts that you learned about before, earlier in this course that actually give the answer for what to do about this conundrum.
cues.zh: 課程前面學過的概念，其實能回答這個難題。

cues.en: That the z-value is gonna change slightly each time you re-run this test.
cues.zh: 也就是每次重跑，Z 會稍微變。

cues.en: So, pause the video if you wanna have a chance to think about this.
cues.zh: 想思考可以暫停。

cues.en: Okay, what did you come up with?
cues.zh: 想到什麼？

cues.en: Well, maybe you're yelling at your computer screen now and I have no idea.
cues.zh: 也許正對螢幕大喊，我卻完全不知道。

cues.en: Okay, so it turns out the solutions are to take advantage of the law of large numbers and the central limit theorem.
cues.zh: 解法是利用大數法則和中央極限定理。

cues.en: So, it turns out that if you repeat the permutation testing multiple times, so you're still using, let's say, 1,000 permutations, but you just keep rerunning it over and over and over again.
cues.zh: 多次重複置換檢定，例如每次仍用 1000 次置換，但一直重跑。

cues.en: And each time you rerun it, you store the z-value, you can create a distribution of those z-values.
cues.zh: 每次儲存 Z，就能建立 Z 值分布。

cues.en: And those z-values will start converging towards some true underlying z-value.
cues.zh: 它們會開始收斂到某個真正底層 Z 值。

cues.en: Okay, so I have a figure that illustrates this plot.
cues.zh: 這張圖就是示範。

cues.en: So, what I did here is a little bit similar to some of the exercises in the section from probability theory.
cues.zh: 和機率理論章的一些練習類似。

cues.en: So ,first what I did is rerun the permutation test, exactly this, exactly this code, except I changed the number of permutations
cues.zh: 重跑完全相同的置換程式，只改置換次數，

cues.en: and I started it at, I believe, 100, yeah.
cues.zh: 我想從 100 開始，對。

cues.en: So, I started with 100 permutations, and then I just ran this again, I computed the z-value, ran it again, compute the z-value, ran it again, compute the z-value, and so on.
cues.zh: 先 100 次，計算 Z，再執行、計算 Z，依此類推。

cues.en: But each time I rerun it, I'm increasing the number of permutations.
cues.zh: 但每次重跑，都增加置換次數。

cues.en: So, this parameter here started off as 100 and it ends up going up to 5,000.
cues.zh: 參數從 100 開始，最後到 5000。

cues.en: And you can see this is pretty similar to what you saw in the section on probability theory.
cues.zh: 和機率理論章看到的很類似。

cues.en: In general, there are kind of the variance is decreasing as we increase the number of permutations, but it never really settles on a particular value.
cues.zh: 一般而言，置換次數增加，變異會減少，但從未真正穩定在特定值。

cues.en: However, the central limit theorem tells us that this distribution of these z-values will become Gaussian, will approach a Gaussian distribution
cues.zh: 但中央極限定理告訴我們，隨著這些值越來越多，它們的分布會接近高斯，

cues.en: as we get more and more of these things, and that's what this looks like here.
cues.zh: 這裡就看到。

cues.en: So, this is the histogram of these z-values.
cues.zh: 這是 Z 值直方圖。

cues.en: And then, we know from the law of large numbers that the true population value is going to be the average, or I should say it the other way, the average of all of these z-values
cues.zh: 接著根據大數法則，真正母體值會是平均，應該反過來說，所有 Z 的平均，

cues.en: will converge towards the true population value as we increase the number of these sample statistics.
cues.zh: 會隨這些樣本統計量增加，收斂到真正母體值。

cues.en: So, basically the average of this distribution is a good estimate of our true underlying z-value.
cues.zh: 所以分布平均，是底層真正 Z 值的好估計。

cues.en: It's gonna be a much better estimate than any one permutation.
cues.zh: 比任何一次置換更好。

cues.zh: 記住，這裡表示的是 Z 值，也就是從虛無假設分布

cues.en: to this empirical, our observed value here.
cues.zh: 到實驗觀察值的正規化距離。
